title: Board of Alders roster
publisher: City of New Haven — Board of Alders / Legislative Services
description: Find elected representatives and their published ward contact information.
fields: Original ward label, including suffixes such as 1-D. One row has an empty cell.
Published contact address; not included in the verification export
Published contact ZIP code; not included in the verification export
Published telephone field; not included in the verification export
steps: Open the city's List of Alders page to view the official roster.

For a reproducible import, use the roster verification script from the repository and run python3 scripts/verify-alders.py from the repository root. It reads the official HTML table and writes a small JSON verification export.
The JSON export preserves ward_label and representative, and derives a numeric ward only when a label is present. Preserve null for missing values; do not assign a ward from row position.
Use the shared validation workflow to rerun the check on demand. Its report distinguishes successful extraction from missing data and access failures.
Check important representation details against the city roster before relying on them; extraction alone does not verify current officeholding.
contact: Board of Alders / Legislative Services; website-maintenance contact not confirmed.
limitations: One representative row has no ward identifier. Preserve the missing value; do not infer Ward 10 from row position or the list of other wards.

The tested export contains ward, ward_label and representative only. Contact-field extraction has not been tested. Preserve original ward labels; the meaning of suffixes such as 1-D remains unverified.

Access relies on parsing the city's HTML table and may break if its structure changes. No official roster API or CSV download has been verified; the JSON verification export is generated by this repository.
Successful extraction does not confirm current officeholding, historical terms, update frequency or reuse permissions. Confirm those details before relying on them.
next: Verify the unlabelled representative's ward using a separate official reference before building complete ward-based lookup.
Confirm a published correction contact, update cadence and reuse terms.
Keep the parser and assertions aligned with documented city-table changes.

evidence.note: Live GitHub-runner retrieval returned HTTP 200; table headings WARD, NAME, ADDRESS, ZIP CODE and Telephone # were read. Thirty representative rows extracted; 29 numeric ward IDs and one empty WARD cell.
Parser tests cover suffixed ward labels, a separate image column, blank identifiers, malformed labels and unrelated pages. Empty identifiers are preserved as null.
Shared, read-only validation runner repeats retrieval and extraction on demand and weekly. Source checks do not verify elected-office status or reuse rights.

build_readiness.summary: All 30 representative rows can be imported from the HTML table, but one lacks a ward identifier and needs an official check before complete ward-based lookup.
preparation: Resolve the source's empty ward identifier without assuming a ward from row position.
Confirm current officeholding, correction contact, refresh schedule and reuse terms for the intended use.
